title: The Night Mason
text: A mason knocks at your gate after midnight. He will raise a new building for your House before the cock crows, he says, and his price is small: a lock of hair and a tooth from everyone who lives under your roof. He has the pliers with him.

options.label: Agree to his price: hair and teeth from everyone. A building by dawn is worth a gap in the smile.

outcomes.text: In the morning the building stands, perfect, with no mortar in its joints. Everyone in your House has a gap in their smile, and the eldest have aged overnight.

options.label: Offer him a recruit instead, and spare the rest of the House.

outcomes.text: He looks the recruit over, nods, and takes them by the hand. The building is up by dawn. The recruit is in the mortar, somewhere.

options.label: Send him away. Nothing built at midnight stands on honest ground.

outcomes.text: He tips his cap and goes to the next Seat along. You hear the pliers through the wall.
